title: ToDo List Application
description: Developed a fully responsive ToDo List application using React.js, Empployed modern development practices, including custom hooks, Context API for state management, and module CSS for styling
Allows users to add, delete,delete,clearAll and mark tasks as completed.
Supports persistent data storage using the browser's local storage, ensuring tasks remain saved between sessions.
Responsive design that works seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
No backend required, fully functional in the browser for a lightweight experience.
